name: Hannah Lund
source:
The prefect of the Illusionist class, Hannah lives her life by the book and with the book. Piles of books, actually. She has big dreams, and is willing to work hard to reach them. For Hannah, fun and adventure are luxuries she just can't afford.

[From in-game profile]
